reviews.title: Used to be decent years ago-now a 1.35-star cash grab flooded with bots
reviews.text: Do not let the legacy 4.1 overall score fool you. If you look at actual feedback from real users over the past year, the rating plunges to a miserable 1.35 out of 5 stars-and it deserves every bit of that drop. Years ago, the platform maybe be functional, had real people, and was actually worth logging into. Today, it is an outright scam and a shadow of what it used to be. The entire ecosystem is overrun with automated AI bots, fake accounts, and catfishers whose only purpose is baiting you into burning expensive credits. Every basic interaction is trapped behind an aggressive paywall, charging ridiculous fees just to open or send a message to profiles that vanish or turn out to be scripts. When an app goes from a usable service to a 1.35-star bot farm, you know management has completely stopped caring about authentic connections and shifted entirely to predatory gouging. Save your time, save your money, and stay far away.

reviews.title: Ashley Madison – Complete Scam, Scammers/Bots Everywhere, Waste of Money! App should be banned.
reviews.text:
Total rip-off and a blatant scam. This app forces you to buy expensive credits just to do anything meaningful—like sending messages, replying, or even viewing new ones (it costs credits to open “collect” messages). The second you load up on credits, your inbox floods with flirty messages from “women” who keep chatting just long enough to drain them all.
But guess what? Almost every single one is a bot or scammer. They use scripted responses, push you to move to WhatsApp/Telegram/Signal right away, and then hit you with extortion schemes, crypto scams, or fake sob stories begging for money. You’re tempted to keep spending credits chasing a real connection, only to realize it was all fake.
Unbelievable that this app is still allowed on the App Store and Google Play—it’s been exposed for using bots for years, yet nothing changes. The high ratings (around 4 stars) must be fake too; no real user would rate it that highly with this many scammers and zero genuine matches for most men.
I strongly advise everyone: DO NOT use Ashley Madison. Save your money and avoid the frustration. Before even thinking about any transaction, research real user feedback on Reddit (search r/adultery or similar)—you’ll see the same warnings over and over.
And whatever you do, NEVER post explicit pictures on your profile or send them to anyone on here. It’s a haven for blackmailers and scammers. Biggest regret—stay far away!
